mapper.sql: SELECT U.ASSET_NO, U.ITEM_CODE, I.ITEM_NM, I.USE_AT, U.STTUS, U.USER_ID, E.USER_NM, U.RM , U.FRST_REGISTER_ID, U.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, U.LAST_UPDUSR_ID, U.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM FROM ASSET_UNIT U JOIN ASSET_ITEM I ON I.ITEM_CODE = U.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN COMTNEMPLYRINFO E ON E.EMPLYR_ID = U.USER_ID
mapper.select: SELECT ASSET_NO, ITEM_CODE, STTUS, USER_ID FROM ASSET_UNIT WHERE ASSET_NO IN #{no} ORDER BY ASSET_NO FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET_UNIT WHERE ASSET_NO = #{assetNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ASSET_UNIT (ASSET_NO, ITEM_CODE, STTUS, USER_ID, RM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM) VALUES (#{vo.assetNo}, #{vo.itemCode}, 'STORED', NULL, #{vo.rm}, #{actorId}, SYSDATE())

INSERT INTO ASSET_UNIT_HIST (UNIT_HIST_ID, ASSET_NO, BEFORE_STTUS, AFTER_STTUS, RESN, REQ_NO, PROCESS_ID, PROCESS_PNTTM) VALUES (#{unitHistId}, #{assetNo}, #{beforeSttus}, #{afterSttus}, #{resn}, #{reqNo}, #{processId}, SYSDATE())
mapper.select: SELECT H.UNIT_HIST_ID, H.ASSET_NO, H.BEFORE_STTUS, H.AFTER_STTUS, H.RESN, H.REQ_NO, H.PROCESS_ID, E.USER_NM AS PROCESS_NM, H.PROCESS_PNTTM FROM ASSET_UNIT_HIST H LEFT JOIN COMTNEMPLYRINFO E ON E.EMPLYR_ID = H.PROCESS_ID WHERE H.ASSET_NO = #{assetNo} ORDER BY H.UNIT_HIST_ID
